analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI at 35.3, holding neutral after exiting oversold. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains in bearish territory. A higher low is forming (5-day low > 20-day low), but the price is still 51.78% below SMA200, indicating a weak trend reversal signal. ADX at 29.5 suggests a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, indicating persistent downward pressure. Lacking clear bullish signals for entry.
